name: Angry Birds Heikki
storyline: The pigs have escaped with the birds' eggs in a stone Formula 1 car, and the birds must chase them across levels that update to match the real-world F1 race calendar.
summary: This puzzle game was a time-limited promotional tie-in with Formula 1 driver Heikki Kovalainen, released to coincide with the 2012 F1 season. Its levels were updated to match the race calendar. A defining mechanic was the "Heikki Power," a special code-activated ability that, when triggered, would summon Terence wearing Kovalainen's branded helmet as a powerful substitute bird.
